topic: Properties and Characteristics of Light and Sound
key_concepts: Light and sound are forms of energy that travel in waves.
Transparent materials allow light to pass through clearly.
Translucent materials allow some light through and scatter it, making images fuzzy.
Opaque materials block light and do not allow it to pass through.
Reflection is the bouncing of light off smooth opaque surfaces at the same angle.
Refraction is the bending of light when it passes from one transparent medium to another.
A pencil in water appears bent or broken due to refraction.
White light can be separated into seven colors: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo,
Rainbows form through refraction and reflection of sunlight in raindrops.
Loudness of sound depends on energy, vibrating body area, and listener distance.
Sound can be reflected as an echo when it hits hard materials.
